Software Engineers (Backend / Frontend / Platform / QA) | Robotics & AI Startup
✅ Robotics · ✅ AI · ✅ Platform Engineering
>> Build Software for Real Robots Operating in the Physical World <<
Location :
Seoul, South Korea
A fast-growing Robotics & Physical AI company is expanding its engineering team and hiring multiple Software Engineers across Backend, Frontend, Platform Software, and QA.
This is an opportunity to work on real-world robotic systems deployed in industrial environments and help build the software infrastructure behind the next generation of intelligent machines.
Open Roles
✅
Backend Engineer
Python / FastAPI / Cloud / Data Pipeline
Build scalable backend services responsible for robot telemetry, fleet management, deployment systems, APIs, and data infrastructure.
✅
Frontend Engineer
React / TypeScript / Data Visualization
Build dashboards and operational tools used to monitor, manage, and analyze robot fleets operating in real-world environments.
✅
Platform Software Engineer
C++ / Linux / System Software
Develop core software infrastructure that enables robots to operate safely and reliably in production environments.
✅
QA Engineer
Linux / Testing / Automation
Verify software quality, reliability, and performance across robot deployments, simulations, and production environments.
Why Join?
Real-world Robotics (not just simulation)
Build systems used by actual deployed robots
Work with Robotics, AI, Controls, Embedded and Software Engineers
Strong ownership and career growth opportunities
Opportunity to grow into senior technical or leadership roles
High-impact engineering environment with direct exposure to company growth
Ideal Background,
engineers with experience in:
Backend Engineering or Frontend Engineering or Platform Engineering
Robotics
AI Systems, Data Platforms
Cloud Services, IoT, Embedded Systems
Software QA
Apply
When applying, please indicate which area best matches your experience:
Platform Software (C++)
Backend Engineering
Frontend Engineering
QA Engineering
